observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Stage of an auditorium or theater with seated audience and an accompanying folk music orchestra seated in a semi-circle behind the dancers
observation.dancers: A couple: one man and one woman
observation.formation_and_space: Solo couple performing on a raised stage, facing each other or turning side-by-side while maintaining personal space
observation.posture: Upright torso, upright carriage with occasional slight inclination during turns, knees active in stepping and leg extensions
observation.footwork: Rhythmic quick steps, taps, heel clicks, and leg extensions or kicks on beat
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held curved overhead or out to the sides, fingers snapping or holding castanets (held objects visible in hands)
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso upright and relatively still while hips move naturally with steps and turns
observation.partnering: Non-contact partnering with parallel and mirrored movements, occasional hand-in-hand turns
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Upright levels with brisk spinning turns and energetic leg kicks
observation.costume_and_props: Traditional regional costume: woman wears a patterned long skirt, red fringed shawl, and hair in a bun; man wears white shirt, patterned vest, dark trousers, white hose, and head covering. Both hold castanets.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot articulation details like toe-heel nuances are obscured by stage distance and video compression
